reference_paper: Temporal Drift-Regularization and Hyperparameter Optimization for Phase-Change Memory-based Neural Network Applications
adaptation: Plot styles only; plotted data are the user full-run ResNet-32/CIFAR-10 results, not the reference paper results
band_definition: plus/minus twice the sample SD (ddof=1) across training-repetition means; not a 95 percent confidence interval
main_time_axis: equally spaced labeled timestamp positions, matching the visual layout of reference Figure 2
heatmap_definition: upper-right triangle: accuracy difference at 20s; lower-left triangle: accuracy difference at five years
